name: Private Eyes
description: Ex-pro hockey player Matt Shade irrevocably changes his life when he teams up with fierce P.I. Angie Everett to form an unlikely investigative powerhouse.

videos.title: Webseries: Trust Issues (1)
videos.overview: Shade and Angie are celebrating a successful week, when Glen Danton shows up looking for Angie’s dad. He claims to be a former client. Having just escaped from prison, Danton is armed and dangerous—and he has nothing left to lose.

videos.title: Webseries: Trust Issues (2)
videos.overview: Angie searches her dad’s files looking for a window into Danton’s case. There’s only so much she can do from the agency, but Danton is paranoid. Shade will have to stay behind, and if Angie’s not back in an hour, Shade will pay the price.

videos.title: Webseries: Trust Issues (3)
videos.overview: Angie pays Kurtis Mazhari a visit at the station, and uncovers important info about Case 298. The clock is running out, so Shade buys himself more time with a high-stakes game of trash-ketball.

videos.title: Webseries: Trust Issues (4)
videos.overview: In the conclusion of Trust Issues, Angie reveals the secret behind Case 298. But with Mazhari and his team about the kick down the door, will Danton believe her?

videos.title: The Code
videos.overview: When a pro hockey prospect goes down on the ice surrounded by suspicious circumstances, Shade and Angie must join forces to solve the mystery and save a life.

videos.title: Mise En Place
videos.overview: Shade and Angie investigate high-profile murder in a popular Toronto restaurant.

videos.title: The Money Shot
videos.overview: Shade and Angie search for a prized racehorse. Shade considers cheating on his P.I. exam.

videos.title: The Devil's Playground
videos.overview: Shade and Angie search for an arsonist and killer in the Toronto Islands. Shade's ego grows with his newly-minted P.I. license.

videos.title: The Six
videos.overview: A 14-year-old witness to a shooting must be protected. Shade tries to figure out who Angie spent the night with while trying to keep a promise to his daughter.

videos.title: Partners in Crime
videos.overview: Shade and Angie go undercover to try to expose a con artist. Angie, Jules and Don give Shade romantic advice.

videos.title: Karaoke Confidential
videos.overview: A hipster hires Shade and Angie to protect him from danger.

videos.title: I Do, I Do
videos.overview: When a lifestyle company’s CEO is threatened, Shade and Angie need to find the source, despite her insistence that everything is going according to her very complicated plan.

videos.title: Disappearing Act
videos.overview: Shade and Angie track a magician who escaped police custody. Shade receives a tantalizing offer.

videos.title: Family Jewels
videos.overview: Shade and Angie go undercover as an engaged couple when a family heirloom is stolen.

videos.title: The Extra Mile
videos.overview: The owner of a car racing team hires Shade and Angie. Angie and Shade adapt to their new roles.

videos.title: Boardwalk Empire
videos.overview: Zoe Chow hires Shade and Angie to find out who broke into her apartment.

videos.title: The Frame Job
videos.overview: A teacher is accused of an inappropriate relationship and Shade and Angie investigate.

videos.title: Crimes of Fashion
videos.overview: Fashion designer Carla Costa hires Shade and Angie to guard her new collection.

videos.title: Now You See Her...
videos.overview: A brilliant orchestra conductor hires Shade and Angie to find his missing fiancée. But there’s a catch – she died 3 years ago.

videos.title: The PI Code
videos.overview: A lawyer hires Shade and Angie to investigate jury tampering.

videos.title: Between a Doc and a Hard Place
videos.overview: Angie and Shade are hired to find out who's targeting a pro-bono medical clinic.

videos.title: Six Feet Blunder
videos.overview: Shade and Angie are hired to find a missing body, but wind up uncovering a scheme to bury millions of dollars.

videos.title: The Good Soldier
videos.overview: Shade and Angie investigate the case of a missing Army Cadet.

videos.title: Kissing the Canvas
videos.overview: After being hired by a boxer to prove a fight was fixed, Shade is sucker-punched when he meets the boxer's manager.

videos.title: Long Live the King
videos.overview: The King From Medieval Times hires Angie and Shade after believing he has been poisoned.

videos.title: Getaway With Murder
videos.overview: Shade and Angie are hired by the owner of a luxurious rustic lodge to investigate an infidelity case.

videos.title: A Fare to Remember
videos.overview: During a routine sting operation, Shade and Angie pick up an unexpected fare with Maz and Nolan hot on their trail.

videos.title: Finding Leroy
videos.overview: Maz's sister comes to Angie for help recovering an aquatic creature that's gone missing from Ripley's Aquarium.

videos.title: The Hills Have Eyes
videos.overview: Shade and Angie go undercover when a young boy believes that his neighbour was murdered.

videos.title: Look Who's Stalking
videos.overview: Becca is worried that a past stalker is back and hires Shade and Angie to investigate the world of media, fame and celebrity obsession.

videos.title: Brew the Right Thing
videos.overview: A couple of brewing brothers hire Shade and Angie to find out who's trying to sabotage their award-winning beer.

videos.title: Shadow of a Doubt
videos.overview: A computer programmer hires Shade and Angie to recover a hard drive, which is locked in a secure lab.

videos.title: Catch Me If You Can
videos.overview: Behind bars, Angie meets an intimidating inmate.

videos.title: Full Court Press
videos.overview: A basketball player asks Angie and Shade to investigate when his wife is caught on film apparently having an affair. Maz and Zoe decide to break up.

videos.title: Cut and Run
videos.overview: Nora is back with a beau who hires Shade and Everett after his clinic's database is hacked.

videos.title: The Life of Riley
videos.overview: A motorcycle shop owned by one of Angie's acquaintances is vandalized.

videos.title: The Grape Deception
videos.overview: Angie's college roommate calls for help when a bottle of wine is stolen.

videos.title: Hog Day Afternoon
videos.overview: Shade ends up in the middle of a hostage situation in a high-rise office, while Maz attempts to control the situation on the ground.

videos.title: Dance Dance Retribution
videos.overview: When Becca calls on Shade and Angie to investigate a series of potentially supernatural accidents that threaten to derail her new TV special, the PI's find themselves tap dancing their way through the cut throat world of reality television.

videos.title: The Conroy Curse
videos.overview: Deputy Conroy needs help with a murder case.

videos.title: It Happened One Fight
videos.overview: Angie and Shade investigate the mysterious collapse of Zoe's Cousin.

videos.title: Tex Therapy
videos.overview: Shade and Angie investigate Tex, a charming man with amnesia who may be linked to an expensive art heist.

videos.title: Aye, Aye, Tonya
videos.overview: Shade and Angie think they're uncovering a simple case of infidelity when they're swept onto the high seas aboard a pirate-themed cruise ship where costumes, treasure, and eye patches are just a cover for a more insidious scheme.

videos.title: Glazed and Confused
videos.overview: Angie's long-time nemesis Norm Glinski fakes his own death, and hires her and Shade to investigate.

videos.title: Family Plot
videos.overview: A former athlete teams up with a fierce P.I. to form an investigative powerhouse.

videos.title: Gumbo for Hire
videos.overview: A former athlete teams up with a fierce P.I. to form an investigative powerhouse.

videos.title: The P.I. Vanishes
videos.overview: A former athlete teams up with a fierce P.I. to form an investigative powerhouse.

videos.title: The Proof is Out There
videos.overview: A concerned husband lands at the Everett and Shade agency fearing that his wife is no longer his wife; Shade and Angie follow the woman and amass a series of clues that lead them to suspect she's involved in many things.

videos.title: All's Fair in Love and Amor
videos.overview: A Mexican telenovela is plagued with near-fatal accidents targeting the lead actors and a decades-old unsolved murder. Kate might be losing faith in a relationship.

videos.title: Tappa Kegga Daily
videos.overview: Zoe's away at a blood-spatter conference, so when a local sorority girl gets mixed up in a valuable comic-book theft, Shade and Angie lean on Liam, Jules, and Becca for help.

videos.title: Under Par-essure
videos.overview: A stalker targets a female golf pro during a celebrity golf tournament; Shade and Angie try to discover the culprit; Romance blooms between Shade and actress Willow Marshall; Angie seeks out some much-needed fun.

videos.title: Blueprint for Murder
videos.overview: A high-rise office cleaner witnesses a murder in the new condo building next door, prompting Shade and Angie to dig into the dark side of the success-obsessed urban professional.

videos.title: A Star Is Torn
videos.overview: In the midst of the Toronto International Film Festival, a famous action star hires Shade and Angie to track down a missing heirloom in time for his big premiere.

videos.title: Smoke Gets in Your Eyes
videos.overview: Becca's new documentary is put on hold when the jazz club she's featuring is set on fire by an unknown arsonist, the club's famous owner goes missing, and the police begin searching for him, claiming that he tried to destroy his own club.

videos.title: The Perfect Storm
videos.overview: It's the day of Danica and Kate's wedding, and a sudden storm strands the wedding guests on a Muskoka island where a plane crash and a wounded pilot unravel a mystery involving buried treasure and mistaken identities.

videos.title: Drop Dead Carny
videos.overview: In the colorful lights of a midway, Shade and Angie stumble upon the body of a carnival worker and are thrust deep into the world of traveling carnies, an eerily accurate psychic and a ring of thieves.

videos.title: In the Arms of Morpheus
videos.overview: During her recovery from an injury, Angie hears someone threatened from her hospital room while under the influence of a drug; no one believes her.

videos.title: School's Out for Murder
videos.overview: At Angie's high school reunion, she drags Shade along so she doesn't have to confront her ex-BFF, Jada Berry, alone. After a body ends up on the dance floor, it's up to the PE crew to solve the mysterious murder.

videos.title: Dead Air
videos.overview: When local radio therapist, Dr. Rohan Love, starts acting strangely and spending huge sums of money, his wife Meera hires Shade and Angie to find out what secret he's hiding.

videos.title: Gone in 60 Minutes
videos.overview: Shade's precious Porsche is stolen at a luxury car show and he suspects his old hockey rival Mark "Lytnin'" Lyte might be to blame. Meanwhile, Angie struggles with PTSD.

videos.title: Murder They Wrote
videos.overview: When a young writer close to fame and fortune is threatened and then a famous guest drops dead, Shade, Angie and Tex find themselves following a trail of clues that lead them into a world of jealousy, desperation and greed.

videos.title: Angie Get Your Gun
videos.overview: While visiting Nora and her serious boo, Rory, Shade and Angie learn that a pair of Billy the Kid's cowboy boots have gone missing from the local museum. When Rory gets fingered as the prime suspect, Angie and Shade race to find Billy's secret.

videos.title: Smart Home Alone
videos.overview: Financial advisor, calls the Private Eyes team for help when she suspects her high-tech smart house has developed a mind of its own. After Shade and Angie are nearly steamed to death, they suspect someone is hacking into her smart home system.

videos.title: Queen's Gambit
videos.overview: A simple robbery case at a local drag club ends up being more complicated than expected. As Shade and Angie race to stop a bank heist, they admire their clients' ability to be true to themselves and express their feelings.
